description: Retrieve Public Assistance (PA) funded project records for a disaster or state — shows where federal recovery money was obligated. Returns applicant, damage category, project size and status, federal share obligated, and total obligated amounts. Either disaster_number or state must be provided. Use disaster_number (from fema_search_disasters) to scope to a single declaration, or state to browse all PA projects for a state. PA projects are created only when the PA program is declared (pa_declared: true on the disaster). A page holds at most 100,000 characters of projects; when projects remain past it, next_offset is the offset to continue from.

county.description: Filter by county name (e.g., Harris, dekalb). Case-insensitive substring match: harris also matches Harrison.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number to scope results to a single declaration. Numbers above 32767 match no declaration.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (1–10000, default 100). A page also stops at 100,000 characters of projects (roughly 220 projects); when either bound leaves matching projects out, next_offset names the offset to continue from.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Pass the previous page’s next_offset to continue.

state.description: Two-letter state code to browse all PA projects for a state.

name: fema_get_public_assistance

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: The state parameter is not a valid 2-letter US state/territory code. `missing_filter`: Neither disaster_number nor state was provided. `not_found`: The disaster number is above 32767, the highest number OpenFEMA holds, so no declaration exists. `no_results`: No PA project records found for the given filters. `request_too_long`: The county value makes the request URL longer than the roughly 8,900 characters OpenFEMA accepts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page: offset plus returned_count. Present only while matching projects remain past this page; pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Paging guidance: the offset to continue from and whether limit or the response budget ended the page, or, when offset is at or past the end, the total and the last valid offset.

projects.description: Public assistance funded project records from offset onward, bounded by limit and by 100,000 characters of projects.

items.description: A single Public Assistance funded project record.

applicant_id.description: FEMA applicant identifier for the recipient organization. Absent when not recorded.

application_title.description: Name of the applicant organization or project. Absent when not recorded.

county.description: County where the project is located. Absent when not recorded.

damage_category_code.description: FEMA damage category code (e.g., A=Debris Removal, B=Emergency Protective Measures, C=Roads and Bridges). Absent when unclassified.

damage_category_description.description: Human-readable name for the damage category code. Absent when unclassified.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number this project belongs to.

federal_share_obligated.description: Federal dollars obligated for this project in USD; 0 when nothing is obligated.

first_obligation_date.description: ISO 8601 date the first federal obligation was recorded. Absent before obligation.

project_amount.description: Estimated total eligible cost of the project in USD from FEMA's damage survey, without administrative costs. Absent when not yet determined.

project_size.description: Large or Small, set by comparing the eligible amount from the damage survey with the large-project threshold FEMA sets for each fiscal year. Absent when unclassified.

project_status.description: Eligibility status of the project: Eligible (nearly all projects), Pending Eligibility Review, Ineligible, or Withdrawn. Absent when not set.

pw_number.description: Project Worksheet number assigned by FEMA. Absent when not yet assigned.

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation. Absent when not recorded.

total_obligated.description: Federal share of the eligible project amount plus State (recipient) and applicant (subrecipient) administrative costs, in USD; equals federal_share_obligated when no administrative costs are recorded. Holds no non-federal share. 0 when nothing is obligated.

returned_count.description: Number of projects in this response.

totalCount.description: Total matching projects before pagination — exceeds returned_count when results were capped at the limit.

title: Get FEMA Public Assistance Projects
